event: The party comes through the Gate onto Floor 19, the air thick with ash.
The System flags a Sustained Environmental Drain: recovery coefficient 0.65.
Solenne reads the drain notation and writes it down.
Tomás reads the Ash Plain: deep ash and irregularly pulsing thermal fissures.
Tomás chalks notation in the ash and says he needs two encounter sets to model the vents.
Tomás says: 'This is what I have.'
Dayo puts Miriam and Nadia in the protected quadrant.
Nadia checks her Pattern Break readout; her Brightspirit signal reads clean.
In the first encounter, three Ashborn Drifters come out of the thermal corridors.
Tomás calls 'left' and Dayo is already there.
Vesper, her attacks useless on fire-immune Drifters, constrains angles with barriers.
Nadia's Pattern Break pulls the flanking Drifter for four seconds.
Dayo clears the primary two in forty seconds; Tomás and Vesper close on the third.
Tomás updates his vent data with three new points.
Nadia says 'Good'; her signal reads at full register.
In the second encounter a vent shift turns a safe angle into a spawn point.
A fourth Drifter arrives from an unmodeled vector; Dayo moves to contain it.
Miriam takes a partial hit from the third Drifter.
Miriam casts full Mending Touch on the unhurt Dayo, drawing a Drifter's aggro.
Miriam's armor takes two more partial hits before Dayo clears the redirected Drifter.
The encounter ends in fifty-five seconds.
Solenne reads Miriam's Warmhearted signal a degree cooler.
Solenne shifts coverage fifteen degrees, overlapping Miriam's area with Nadia's.
Solenne writes 'Ceiling' in the notebook margin and closes it.
Nadia checks her Pattern Break cooldown; her MP is at 71 percent.
Nadia says 'Good' again, in a slightly thinner voice.
In the third encounter Tomás flags both vectors early; it ends in forty seconds.
Miriam takes an MP inventory with her clinical notebook open.
Solenne makes a smaller secondary formation adjustment in her head.
Nadia says nothing after the encounter; her performance layer has stopped.
Before the fourth encounter Solenne reads Nadia's signal at its lowest since Floor 11.
Solenne weighs narrowing Nadia's Pattern Break window, knowing Nadia would notice.
Tomás tells her he knows what she is calculating, and says nothing else.
Solenne neither confirms nor denies; the encounter opens.
A Drifter comes from the predicted vector, one degree off the predicted angle.
The variance puts it 0.4 seconds outside Nadia's Pattern Break window.
Miriam steps between the Drifter and Tomás and redirects it.
The redirection throws Tomás into the wall at 62/362 HP, Near-Downed.
Vesper's geometry closes on the Drifter and Dayo clears it in four seconds.
Tomás sits up in the ash and checks his own status.
The System resolves Near-Downed status and marks combat complete.
Nadia stands very still, looking at where Tomás landed, her performance layer down.
Solenne's status display notes a 0.4-second defensive response delay.
Tomás is on his feet within two minutes and keeps up the floor notation.
The System marks the rest node eighteen minutes away.
On the walk, Dayo runs a practical debrief, naming the variance as a data point.
Tomás adds two vent observations; Vesper confirms she can replicate her adaptation.
Nadia walks in formation and says nothing.
The party reaches the rest node, where the recovery coefficient is back to 1.0.
Nadia sits against the wall where the walk ended, not in her usual corner.
Tomás settles at the adjacent angle and works on his notation.
The debrief ends and the next encounter set is discussed.
The rest node shows Nadia MP 86/408, Miriam 97/420, Tomás HP recovering to 285/362.
Miriam crosses the rest node and sits an arm's length from Nadia, not asking anything.
A long time passes with both looking at the ash floor.
Nadia says Miriam came across and she didn't see her; she was at 0.4 seconds.
Nadia says she knew Miriam would be there, fast enough every time.
Nadia says that's not the same as knowing she would be.
Miriam says nothing and stays.
Across the node, Solenne reads Nadia's Brightspirit open, not fractured.
Solenne thinks of writing '0.4 seconds' but doesn't.
Solenne thinks over 102 events, RES 20, and the chord.
Solenne concludes the chord is ready and the party is not.
Solenne opens the notebook, writes nothing, and deliberately closes it.
Solenne puts the notebook in her pack.
Vesper fetches a modified Mana Vial and sets it within Miriam's reach without a word.
Vesper returns to her Workframe inscription.
Dayo checks the shoulder armor that took the Floor 18 Lurker hit; Tomás updates his model.
After a while Miriam picks up the vial and drinks it without looking at Vesper.
Nadia's Brightspirit signal strengthens slightly.
The rest node keeps recovering them; Nadia and Miriam sit on, neither moving.
